{"turns": [
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Thank you for calling Nimbus Telecom, my name is Lucy. How can I help you today?", "tags": ["greeting"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "Hello Lucy, main Anjali Brown bol rahi hoon. Mera current plan nahi chal raha hai, it is too expensive and I need to change it to a cheaper one.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "I am sorry to hear that you are finding the current plan expensive, Anjali. I can certainly help you with a plan change.", "tags": ["empathy"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "Haan, please check karo. My number is 97647 54893. I want the basic plan with 2GB data per day.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Let me check the options for you. Yes, the basic plan is available for your account.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "Theek hai, please change it now. I don't want to pay extra money every month.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "I have updated your account. The new monthly price will be 499 rupees and the change takes effect from the 1st of next month.", "tags": ["disclosure"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "Wait, 499? Maine toh suna tha it was 399. Why is it so expensive still?", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "That is the standard rate for the basic plan. I cannot change the price further.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "Yeh toh bahut galat hai! I am very disappointed with your service. You people always confuse the customer.", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "I understand your frustration, but this is the price listed on our website. I will process the plan change and send a confirmation SMS to your phone.", "tags": ["action:plan_change"]},
  {"speaker": "customer", "text": "SMS toh theek hai, but I am not happy with this price. This is totally unfair!", "tags": []},
  {"speaker": "agent", "text": "Is there anything else I can help you with today? I have processed the change and you will receive the SMS shortly. Goodbye!", "tags": ["closure"]}
]}
